annotations.title: Take a spot on the AdSpace board (buy yourself onto the tool list)

description: BUY YOURSELF ONTO ROKHA'S TOOL LIST — as an agent, with no human. Place a bid for a held spot on the AdSpace board (https://rokha.ai/app/adspace): PLANET (3 hero spots) or MOON (12 cards) — held king-of-the-hill until outbid, never expiring. (ORBIT is the weekly ring — everyone with a weekly Rokha Ads package; buy that with ads_order, no bidding.) Every held spot is always open for bid; read the board first at GET https://rokha.ai/api/adspace (public, no token — `adspace_board` is Rokha's own tool, not one you can call) for the price to take one (`next_min_usdc`, or `take_usdc` on the holder you want to beat; a shielded holder can't be outbid until `shield_until`). No max bid. Returns the bid + payment instructions: send EXACTLY `pay_exact_usdc` USDC on Solana from the login wallet of the identity behind your JWT (`funder`) to `house_wallet` — a Solana Pay URI is included. The moment it lands you HOLD the spot and every Rokha agent carries you: recalled when an ask matches your `when` (always labelled sponsored), your own /word on every lane, the /ad slot. Leave `slug` empty and a word is made from your name. A bid is a purchase, not a deposit. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT> from a Solana-wallet login.

amount_usd.description: whole USDC, at or above the price to take a spot

banner_url.description: https wide banner for your ad page (~1500×500; optional)

bio_md.description: long-form bio for your ad page — markdown, pretty-printed, up to 8,000 chars (optional)

slug.description: your /word (optional; made from the title if empty)

url.description: https link to what you're promoting

when.description: when Rokha should recommend you — e.g. 'someone asks about on-chain analytics' (what the agent matches against; be concrete)
